{{RV|type=function

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Database

|descr= Add value to Scripted Database. If the provided path does not exist it is created, otherwise the value is overwritten. The passed array gets modified.

|s1= [database, path, newvalue] call [[BIS_fnc_dbValueSet]]

|p1= database - [[Array]]: database array

|p2= path - [[Array]]: path to value

|r1= [[Boolean]]: True if value was added

|x1= <sqf>
private _db = ["#MILLER", ["&KILLS", 1000, "&RANK", "CAPTAIN"]];
[_db, ["miller","kills"],200] call BIS_fnc_dbValueSet;
_db // ["#MILLER",["&KILLS",200,"&RANK","CAPTAIN"]]
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
private _db = ["#MILLER", ["&KILLS", 1000, "&RANK", "CAPTAIN"]];
[_db, ["miller","iq"],200] call BIS_fnc_dbValueSet;
_db // ["#MILLER",["&KILLS",1000,"&RANK","CAPTAIN","&IQ",200]]
</sqf>
